## PRB1.2. En route service units {#prb1.2.-en-route-service-units .Heading-2-ER}

- Hungary recorded 4,371K actual service units in 2025, +12.3% compared to 2024 (3,892K).

- Actual 2025 service units were +9.5% above the plan (3,993K).

- Actual 2025 service units are +38.2% above the actual 2019 level (3,162K).
